title: EWM Group
description:
EWM Group — the parent group behind Bonmarché, Edinburgh Woollen Mill, and Peacocks, three of the UK's best-known value fashion chains.

The exposed material includes:

503,878 loyalty programme member records — full name, home address, date of birth, phone, mobile, email, loyalty card number, and transaction history spanning 2000–2026.
~21,000 employee records — salary, National Insurance number (via P11D), bank sort code and account number (WAGESTRANSFER database), home address, emergency contacts, maternity/paternity data, sickness absence, accident reports with injury details.

100+ GB of Outlook PST email archives — complete email histories for named staff members spanning years of business operations.
313+ SQL Server database backups across 122 unique databases — the entire digital brain of the retail operation.
83 GB of e-commerce transaction data — every online order from January 2021 to August 2026.
